title: Identifying the musicians in the WWL staff photo
summary: Netto names the players pictured: Almerico, Dave Winstein, Pinky, Lelke, Steve who died on D-Day, and others, taken at WWL in the Roosevelt.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
